config.retrieval_backend: actual worker.search.postgres.channel; concurrent independent channel connections; actual worker.search.fusion.assemble
config.normalization: application index triggers and module normalization, unmodified
config.sensitivity_weights_note: Configured weights are all 1.0; configured and equal weight tests coincide by design.
config.r_precision_definition: R-Precision@K uses relevant hits in first min(K,R) divided by R; standard R-Precision when K>=R.
config.map_definition: AP@K denominator is total gold chunk count R, macro averaged over answerable queries.
config.precision_definition: Relevant distinct chunks divided by requested K; fewer candidates remain missing slots.
config.history_policy: Only current question passed to stateless retrieval, history-bearing follow-up failures retained.
config.gold_policy: All extracted chunks on gold pages are relevant; source/page retrieval does not prove textual answer availability.
config.defect_policy: No app logic/config/gold changes; actual production top5 preserved.
config.execution_context: Local shared host; baseline run 1 had concurrent Ollama memory pressure and baseline run 2 ran while generation was paused. Timings are observed mixed-load diagnostics, not causal production latency comparisons.

models.requirement: Each actual runner must also record observed engine identities and overrides.

metrics.reason: Frozen dataset contains typo/Hinglish variants but no separately labeled paraphrase subset; no new gold questions introduced after freeze.
